phrases.latin: Tum in dormītōrium ad fīlium rediit
phrases.english: Then he went back to the bedroom to his son
phrases.source: Libellus II, Sintra: castellum et puteus

phrases.latin: post, ubi jam thalamīs sē composuēre, silētur in noctem, fessōsque sopor suus occupat artūs
phrases.english: then, when they have settled in their chambers, there is silence for the night, and their own sleep takes hold of their tired limbs (of bees)
